items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 里 in a Western Zhou bronze-script form, sourced to a glyph recorded from 史頌簋.
items.alt: A single dark bronze-script style graph 里, drawn as a clean vector on a transparent or plain background.

items.rights: Public domain ancient-script representation; source page also states that the underlying Xiaoxuetang query glyph image is CC0 1.0.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not a photograph of an excavated inscription. The original SVG endpoint was not visually inspected in this research stage.
No further glyph candidate was selected: inspected Xiaoxuetang search result was labeled 庫, and the Academia Sinica chardb image page declares All Rights Reserved.
